name: @agora/root
description: Agora — reconciliation of harness executions within Workstreams

scripts.check: node scripts/check-dependency-direction.mjs && node scripts/check-forbidden-vocabulary.mjs && node scripts/run-schema-fixtures.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agora/domain && npm run build -w @agora/owner-requests && npm run build -w @agora/observation && npm run build -w @agora/policy && npm run build -w @agora/testkit && npm run build -w @agora/engine && npm run build -w @agora/journal && npm run build -w @agora/acp && npm run build -w @agora/projections && npm run build -w @agora/broker && npm run build -w @agora/harness-claude-code && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agora/domain && npm run typecheck -w @agora/owner-requests && npm run typecheck -w @agora/observation && npm run typecheck -w @agora/policy && npm run typecheck -w @agora/testkit && npm run typecheck -w @agora/engine && npm run typecheck -w @agora/journal && npm run typecheck -w @agora/acp && npm run typecheck -w @agora/projections && npm run typecheck -w @agora/broker && npm run typecheck -w @agora/harness-claude-code && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
